spells.name: Void Shade
spells.effect: Select an enemy unit within 18". It takes a Battle-Shock test.

strategems.name: Rapid Armor Plating
strategems.when: An enemy unit declares an attack
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, the selected unit has !Feel No Pain 6+!. While it is within Hive Will range, it has !Feel No Pain 5+! instead.

strategems.name: Adrenal Rush
strategems.when: A friendly +Hunger+ unit is about to fight.
strategems.target: The friendly +Hunger+ unit that is about to fight.
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, the target unit scores Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+. If the target unit is within Hive Will range, roll d6; on a 4+, regain 1 CP.

strategems.name: Unending Swarm
strategems.when: After a friendly +Hunger+ +Endless Swarm+ unit is destroyed.
strategems.target: The unit that was just destroyed.

upgrades.name: Perfect Adaptation
upgrades.text: Once per Battle Round, your +Warlord+ may reroll one Hit roll, one Wound roll, one Damage roll, one Advance roll, one Charge roll, or one Saving roll.

upgrades.name: Malevolent Cunning
upgrades.text: After both players have deployed their armies, select a friendly +Hunger+ unit and redeploy it. It may be moved in or out of Strategic Reserves.

upgrades.name: Synaptic Biology
upgrades.text: Friendly +Hunger+ units within 8" of a +Hive Will+ unit are also within Hive Will range.
